newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian total March oil exports 9.0 mln T - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russian total March oil exports 9.0 mln T - agency.

text.p: Russia exported 9.0 million tonnes (2.16 million barrels per day) of oil in March, 8.15 million tonnes (1.97 million bpd) of it moving outside the Commonwealth of Independent States, the State Customs Committee said Tuesday.

The committee, quoted by Interfax news agency, said that the March total was up 0.98 million tonnes from February. The main destinations of Russian crude in March were Ireland, Germany, Poland and Switzerland.
The committee was also quoted as saying that total Russian exports during the first quarter of 1997 reached 26.22 million tonnes (2.10 million bpd).
